ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white/light-gray) pixels covering approximately 90% of the interior surface, contrasted against a low-intensity (dark-gray/black) peripheral border and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous light-gray region across the central area of both lobes. Dark pigmentation is concentrated in a 2-5 pixel width band along the trailing edge. A cluster of dark, punctate spots is located along the vertical midline extending from the peduncle to the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped indentation with an estimated interior angle of 145 degrees; the depth of the notch is approximately 4% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel amplitudes ranging from 2 to 10 pixels. Significant jagged indentations are visible on the distal third of both lobes, particularly a deep notch on the right lobe near the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a slight concave sweep from the notch toward the tips, which terminate in sharp, upward-pointing vertices.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast, dark textured pixels are visible at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes, consistent with barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, distinct, diagonal linear mark of reddish-brown hue is located in the upper-right quadrant of the right lobe, approximately 30 pixels in length.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable reddish-brown linear marking on the right lobe; several dark circular spots clustered near the base of the fluke/peduncle junction.
other_distinctive_markers: The reddish pigmentation of the linear mark on the right lobe is a highly unique visual marker against the otherwise monochromatic surface.
